response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG(s.boxx * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS ratio FROM projects p JOIN scanspatial s ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE s.boxx IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), m AS (SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS margin FROM r) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, margin FROM m ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
